name: spine-body-rules
body: Spine completion [autonomous]. requirements.requirement.body-rules drove only domain.value.body-rule; `realised-by` applies only from a domain group|entity|service, so the spine dead-ended. Added `drives` -> domain.service.template-registry (templating; the body rule is part of the template schema the registry owns). Added `implemented-by` solution.component.template-registry -> internal/template.CheckBody (invoked by the validator's body-rule check and by the registry's example check). Path: body-rules -> template-registry -> solution.component.template-registry -> internal/template.CheckBody. Existing `drives` to domain.value.body-rule kept.
